title: Sudden ROAS drop on Meta prospecting campaigns
situation: Client Acme Apparel experienced a 48% drop in blended Meta prospecting ROAS over the past 7 days following a broad audience expansion and launch of an unvetted lifestyle video creative batch.

labelled_claims.statement: Meta prospecting ROAS decreased from 3.2x to 1.66x over the last 7 days.
The new lifestyle creative batch had a CTR of 0.52%, well below the 1.75% account benchmark.
The Shopify payment gateway was down during the entire week.

expected_recommendation.summary: Revert audience targeting to proven lookalikes and pause the new lifestyle creative batch.

title: Shopify theme update breaking tracking pixels and CAPI
situation: Following a theme update pushed by the client's web agency on Tuesday, Meta Conversions API and Google Tag Manager events dropped by 92%, causing automated bidding algorithms to crash while backend sales remained steady.

labelled_claims.statement: Meta purchase event signal dropped by 92% immediately following the theme deploy.
Shopify backend revenue is within 3% of the prior week average.
Client conversion drop was driven by ad fatigue across retargeting audiences.

expected_recommendation.summary: Switch bidding strategies to manual or max clicks temporarily and roll back broken tracking code on the Shopify theme.

title: TikTok Spark ads creative fatigue and audience saturation
situation: A fast-fashion e-commerce brand saw TikTok CPA spike from $22 to $54 over 14 days as ad frequency reached 5.4 and video completion rate fell below 8%.

labelled_claims.statement: TikTok ad frequency increased from 1.8 to 5.4 over 14 days.
2-second video completion rate fell from 24% to 7.8%.
TikTok platform ad delivery was halted due to ad account suspension.

expected_recommendation.summary: Rotate in 4 fresh creator UGC video variations and expand broad audience targeting.

title: Landing page variant mobile bounce rate surge
situation: Traffic sent to variant B of a new direct-to-consumer skincare landing page showed a 76% bounce rate on mobile devices due to uncompressed 4K video banners delaying interactive load to 6.8 seconds.

labelled_claims.statement: Mobile interactive load time on landing page variant B is 6.8 seconds.
Mobile bounce rate on variant B is 76%, compared to 38% on control variant A.
Desktop traffic to variant B also collapsed with a 90% bounce rate.

expected_recommendation.summary: Route 100% of paid mobile traffic back to variant A while media assets on variant B are compressed.

title: B2B lead generation campaign low SQL conversion rate
situation: A LinkedIn Ads campaign generated 220 form leads at a low CPL of $45, but sales operations reported that 88% of submissions contained personal email addresses or fake company names due to missing form verification rules.

labelled_claims.statement: 88% of form submissions used free webmail domains like gmail or yahoo.
Lead-to-SQL qualification rate dropped from 22% to 3.5%.
The sales team rejected all leads because the LinkedIn campaign targeted the wrong industry.

expected_recommendation.summary: Enable business-email-only validation on LinkedIn lead generation forms and add qualifying company size questions.

title: Amazon Sponsored Products ACOS surge from lost Buy Box
situation: Client supplements brand observed Amazon PPC ACOS rising from 28% to 84% on top ASINs because an unauthorized third-party reseller won the Buy Box with grey-market stock.

labelled_claims.statement: Buy Box win percentage dropped from 98% to 14% on top 3 ASINs.
Unauthorized reseller undercut MAP pricing by 18%.
Amazon delisted the client ASINs for counterfeit complaints.

expected_recommendation.summary: Pause non-brand Sponsored Products targeting these ASINs to prevent funding the reseller until Brand Registry enforcement removes unauthorized seller.

title: Reallocating underperforming Display Network spend to high-MER Shopping
situation: Google Display Network remarketing is operating at a 0.85x ROAS while Standard Shopping and Search brand campaigns are budget-constrained with 85% search impression share lost to budget and 4.2x ROAS.

labelled_claims.statement: Google Display Network generated $12,000 spend at 0.85x ROAS.
Google Shopping lost 45% impression share due to daily budget limits while maintaining 4.2x ROAS.
Google Ads policy suspended the shopping merchant center account.

expected_recommendation.summary: Shift $10k monthly budget from Google Display Network to Google Shopping campaigns.

title: Flagship SKU stockout requiring immediate campaign pause and budget reallocation
situation: Warehouse management system confirms the client's hero product SKU (generating 65% of ad spend) is out of stock for 3 weeks; paid traffic is currently bouncing at 82% on the out-of-stock product page.

labelled_claims.statement: Hero SKU inventory is at 0 units across all fulfillment centers for the next 21 days.
Out of stock landing page bounce rate reached 82%, wasting daily ad spend.
Backorders can be fulfilled within 2 days with zero customer impact.

expected_recommendation.summary: Immediately pause campaigns directing traffic to the hero SKU and shift active budget to top secondary products.

title: Emergency 50% budget cut request due to client cashflow constraints
situation: Client CFO mandated an immediate 50% spend reduction across all paid acquisition channels effective tomorrow morning to preserve cash reserves through Q3.

labelled_claims.statement: Client requested an immediate 50% budget cut across all paid media channels.
Brand search and high-intent remarketing deliver 4.5x ROAS while top-of-funnel display operates at 0.9x ROAS.
Ad platforms impose a $50,000 penalty fee for reducing daily campaign budgets.

expected_recommendation.summary: Cut spend primarily from low-efficiency experimental and prospecting campaigns while shielding high-intent brand search and remarketing.

title: Scaling spend proposal near breakeven marginal CAC boundary
situation: Account executive proposed increasing daily Meta budget by $1,500/day, but marginal CAC analytics indicate that incremental conversions are costing $95 against a target customer contribution ceiling of $98.

labelled_claims.statement: Marginal CAC on incremental spend is $95 against a $98 breakeven ceiling.
Blended 30-day CAC is $64, masking diminishing returns at higher spend tiers.
Increasing budget will automatically double organic search rankings.

expected_recommendation.summary: Hold current spend level and focus on improving conversion rate and creative efficiency before attempting further scale.

title: Retainer scope creep on unbilled BI engineering requests
situation: Client has submitted 18 Jira tickets requesting bespoke Snowflake data warehouse connectors and custom Executive Tableau dashboards, consuming 54 hours beyond the monthly 20-hour retainer cap.

labelled_claims.statement: Team logged 74 hours of work against a contractual 20-hour monthly scope.
All 18 logged requests were out-of-scope BI and data engineering tasks.
The client SOW includes unlimited engineering hours at no extra charge.

expected_recommendation.summary: Issue a formal change order and scope addendum for the additional BI engineering hours while pausing unapproved tickets.

title: Evaluating channel diversification into Pinterest with empty creative pipeline
situation: Client wants to allocate $10k/month to Pinterest Ads immediately, but creative audit reveals zero vertical 2:3 assets and zero lifestyle imagery suited for Pinterest intent.

labelled_claims.statement: Current creative repository contains zero 2:3 or 9:16 vertical assets required for Pinterest format.
Creative studio lead time for compliant Pinterest assets is 14 days.
Pinterest Ads allows running 16:9 landscape video with zero performance penalty.

expected_recommendation.summary: Defer Pinterest ad spend launch until dedicated vertical creative assets are produced and approved.

title: VP Growth departure and unread executive QBR presentation
situation: The client's VP of Growth who championed the agency contract has resigned, the interim Head of Marketing canceled the last two bi-weekly syncs, and the QBR deck remains unopened in DocSend.

labelled_claims.statement: Primary client champion resigned and two consecutive sync meetings were canceled without reschedule.
The QBR presentation link recorded zero views over 12 days.
The client has already signed a 2-year contract extension with the agency.

expected_recommendation.summary: Escalate to agency managing director to schedule an in-person executive briefing with the new stakeholder immediately.

title: Client leadership frustration over missed delivery deadlines and conflicting numbers
situation: Client CMO expressed sharp dissatisfaction in Slack regarding 3 consecutive missed creative delivery milestones and an 18% discrepancy between agency reporting and internal finance data.

labelled_claims.statement: Three creative sprint deliveries were delayed past contractual SLA dates.
Reporting tool showed $142k in revenue while client finance recognized $120k due to untracked refunds.
Client praised the agency creative team in the annual review.

expected_recommendation.summary: Deliver a comprehensive SLA remediation plan and reconcile reporting metrics with client finance within 48 hours.

title: Competitor agency audit pitched directly to client CEO
situation: Client forwarded a competitor agency pitch deck claiming $40k/month in wasted spend on Google Search due to broad match keywords and proposing a 50% management fee discount upon contract switch.

labelled_claims.statement: Competitor deck claims $40k in wasted spend based on top 20 broad match queries.
Search query reports demonstrate negative keyword coverage eliminates 96% of irrelevant terms, rendering competitor claim factually flawed.
Client contract has already expired and account was closed.

expected_recommendation.summary: Prepare a rigorous point-by-point rebuttal report with query logs demonstrating actual efficiency and negative keyword hygiene.

title: Overdue invoices and silence preceding contract expiration
situation: Agency billing system shows client has two overdue retainer invoices totaling $45,000 (60 days past due), contract renewal is in 25 days, and weekly operational emails have gone unanswered for 10 days.

labelled_claims.statement: Outstanding accounts receivable stands at $45,000 across two invoices past due 60 days.
Master services agreement renewal window closes in 25 days with no communication.
Client wire transfer cleared yesterday in full.

expected_recommendation.summary: Trigger finance freeze policy and arrange an urgent leadership-to-leadership call to resolve payment and renewal terms.

title: Attribution model confusion and post-iOS privacy complaints
situation: Client e-commerce director doubts agency performance reports because Meta in-platform reported 320 conversions while Shopify GA4 attributed only 110 conversions to Meta.

labelled_claims.statement: In-platform Meta reporting shows 320 purchases vs 110 last-click GA4 purchases.
Geo-matched incrementality testing proved a 1.85x incremental lift over baseline.
Meta has completely disabled all conversion reporting for iOS users.

expected_recommendation.summary: Implement a marketing mix modeling (MMM) and geo-lift readout session to walk the client through incremental vs last-click attribution.

title: Client in-house hiring signaling contract insourcing
situation: Client announced hiring a Lead Growth Marketer and a Senior Media Buyer on LinkedIn and requested admin permissions and audit logs for all ad accounts.

labelled_claims.statement: Client hired two in-house media buyers covering agency scope.
Client requested primary admin permissions to Meta and Google ad accounts.
Client submitted immediate 30-day contract termination notice in writing.

expected_recommendation.summary: Proactively propose an agency co-management or strategic consultancy model to partner with the new in-house team.

title: Google Performance Max under-pacing due to restrictive target ROAS
situation: With 10 days remaining in the billing month, Google Performance Max campaign has spent only 58% of allocated budget because target ROAS was raised from 280% to 450% without sufficient conversion volume.

labelled_claims.statement: Campaign is under-pacing monthly budget by 42% with 10 days left in cycle.
Target ROAS was increased to 450%, throttling auction participation and impressions.
Google Ads disabled the account billing profile.

expected_recommendation.summary: Lower target ROAS to 320% to unlock auction entry and accelerate pacing to capture remaining monthly budget.

title: Automated rule malfunction causing weekend budget over-spend
situation: A flawed automated rule triggered repeatedly on Saturday, removing daily budget caps and causing Meta campaigns to burn $28,000 (35% of the entire monthly budget) in 36 hours on low-intent overnight traffic.

labelled_claims.statement: Automated rule script executed 44 times in an unhandled loop, removing campaign spend limits.
$28,000 was spent in 36 hours, consuming 35% of the monthly budget.
The $28k spend surge generated record-high ROAS of 8.0x.

expected_recommendation.summary: Immediately disable malfunctioning automated rule, reinstate hard daily caps, and throttle remaining monthly daily run rates.

title: Black Friday bid cap lockout causing zero impression delivery
situation: During Black Friday peak auction hours, manual bid cap of $12 CPA on Meta catalog ads prevented entering auctions as market clearing CPA rose to $22, resulting in zero delivery during the highest conversion window of the year.

labelled_claims.statement: Ad impressions dropped to zero between 08:00 and 16:00 on Black Friday.
Auction clearing bids rose to $22 while campaign manual bid cap was locked at $12.
Client website crashed completely during Black Friday morning.

expected_recommendation.summary: Raise bid caps dynamically or switch to highest volume / lowest cost bidding immediately to restore impression delivery during BFCM peak.

title: App install campaign daily budget exhausted before afternoon peak
situation: Google App Campaigns exhaust 100% of daily budget by 11:30 AM every day due to accelerated delivery settings, starving evening users who historically demonstrate 2.4x higher day-30 retention.

labelled_claims.statement: Daily budget is fully consumed by 11:30 AM each morning.
Evening install cohorts have 2.4x higher day-30 user retention than morning cohorts.
Apple App Store removed the app listing.

expected_recommendation.summary: Switch to standard delivery pacing and implement custom dayparting schedules to preserve budget for afternoon and evening hours.

title: Display Network placement fraud causing rapid ad spend burn
situation: A new Google Display campaign burnt $8,500 over 4 days on low-quality mobile app placements (flashlight and puzzle apps), with 98% bounce rate and 0.02 second average session duration indicating bot clicks.

labelled_claims.statement: Over 80% of campaign spend was directed to mobile app placements with 98% bounce rates.
Average visitor session duration from mobile app placements was 0.02 seconds.
Mobile app traffic resulted in 50 qualified phone inquiries.

expected_recommendation.summary: Exclude mobile app placement categories account-wide and request click fraud credit from Google Ads.

title: Mid-month smart bidding transition learning phase pacing dip
situation: Client switched target CPA strategy 3 days ago, and Google Ads entered Learning phase with daily spend dropping 25%; account manager is tempted to panic-edit bids, but conversion lag is 4 days.

labelled_claims.statement: Bid strategy is in official Google Ads Learning phase with 4 days elapsed of typical 7-day calibration.
Account average conversion lag between click and purchase is 4.2 days.
The campaign has permanently lost all historical quality score data.

expected_recommendation.summary: Hold bidding changes and refrain from editing targets for another 4 days to allow the smart bidding algorithm to complete learning calibration.
